blocks.text: WASHINGTON, United States — The USS Theodore Roosevelt is operating in the Middle East, the US military said on Monday, bringing the number of American carrier strike groups in the region to three. The Roosevelt and the ships accompanying it add to the already large US naval presence in the region, which includes two other carriers — the George H.W. Bush and the George Washington — and more than a dozen destroyers. “The aircraft carrier is currently operating in the CENTCOM area of responsibility as part of a scheduled deployment,” Central Command — which is responsible for US forces in the Middle […]...
